privileged_info_for_vlm: The task is successful only if the UI font size is explicitly set to 16 or higher and the theme is a dark variant. The required export paths are /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ergonomic_ui.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ui_settings.txt. A CT scan must be visible in the viewer during the process.
